review_kind: independent read-only code, tests, contracts and source-evidence review
basis: Receipt fields are untrusted equality assertions. Successful revalidation returns the new CapturedDeclarations constructed by complete current capture, never an external serialized outcome.

Wire length is capped at 16384 bytes before serde parsing. The strict struct rejects duplicate/missing/unknown fields; wire and derivation versions, caller owner, scope and all three digest encodings are checked before filesystem capture.

The root, explicit authorization and all current capture/AST/model limits come from the new request, not the receipt. Existing complete capture retains native checks, actual configuration loading, AST/model rederivation and final inventory/byte verification.

Separate digest domains and explicit u64 length framing bind all regular-file paths and bytes. Configuration includes the full raw-byte digest and provenance; outcomes include full ordered Derived/Unavailable and empty arrays.
All three digests are compared to freshly derived values. Invalid configuration, AST, native path or current resource limits cannot be bypassed with a previously valid receipt.
The existing python_inventory.rs differs only by six module/export lines; original capture/native/AST/model implementations and old tests remain byte-identical to base.

author_behavioral_evidence.attribution: Read and source-bound verified author logs; not independently rerun by this reviewer.
author_behavioral_evidence.strict_clippy_and_fmt: Author logged exit 0; reviewed, not rerun.

reviewer_executed_checks: Exact git HEAD/tree and clean working tree
Full 766-file manifest membership and SHA256 comparison
Changed crate/Cargo path allowlist and exact six-line export delta
Parsed test result counts from supplied scoped logs
accepted_boundaries: Content identity under a caller-asserted owner; historical root inode/mount/absolute-path continuity and empty directory changes are not serialized.
Receipt generation streams existing admitted bytes/JSON but still costs O(captured bytes plus outputs). Revalidation fully rescans and rederives; no incremental cache or hard RSS/deadline claim.
Only the versioned revalidation subtask is accepted. No DB/MCP publication, non-Linux certification, source-registry acceptance, quality/100k or full P7 gate closure is inferred.
